newsitem.title: USA: Equity Oil writes-off Siberian investment.
newsitem.headline: Equity Oil writes-off Siberian investment.

text.p: Equity Oil said it reported a net loss for the fourth quarter of $0.28 per share, compared with a loss of $0.01 per share in the year-ago period, amid a write-off of its remaining 50 percent investment in Symskaya Exploration Inc, in Eastern Siberia, to focus on its core oil and gas activities in North America.
The company took a partial write-off, effective September 30, in the venture in early November, which resulted in a pretax charge of $5.25 million. After-tax charges were put at $3.2 million.
At that time, the company estimated its remaining investment in Symskaya was $3.7 million as of September 30, 1996.
The company said it will continue to pursue third-party financing for additional drilling on the 1.1 million acre license.
For the year, the company reported a loss of $0.43 per share, compared with a loss of $0.10 per share in 1995, it said.
Company officials were not immediately available to comment further.
